newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish government to appoint Ombudsman for children.
newsitem.headline: Irish government to appoint Ombudsman for children.

text.p: The Irish government is to appoint an ombudsman to promote and protect childrens' rights, Irish media reported on Monday.
The move is among a range of measures to be implemented instead of mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse, which has now been postponed for at least three years.
The announcement followed the publication of a Children's Bill to replace old legislation on juvenile justice.
